note: Re-read 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after commit 60e9406387 removed the RFC6810-7-1 tag from TestRTRUnprotectedTCPFromConfig; no assertion line changed, and the TLS units are unchanged. RFC 8210 Section 3 reads 'A Relying Party, e.g., router or other client, MUST have a trust relationship with, and a trusted transport channel to, any cache(s) it uses.' TLS path: TestRTRTLSAuthenticatedCache completes a mutually authenticated handshake under the named CA over TLS 1.2 and 1.3 and only then publishes the cache's VRP and ASPA; TestRTRTLSRejectsUnauthenticatedCaches shows an issuer outside the named CA, wrong DNS-ID, CN-only, IP-SAN-only and one-way TLS each refused before any record is published. Unprotected path: TestRTRUnprotectedTCPFromConfig syncs and uses data from a cache declared trusted-network, and its negative shows cache-server {} and trusted-network false refused by parseRPKIConfig, the declaration being the only difference from the accepted entry. Both the trust relationship and the trusted channel are asserted on both transports.
